Decision.description: A delegate's resolution of the owner's policy for one exact action.
Decision.title: Decision

V2Request.description: Informational owner messages; verification is issued only by an invocation.
V2Request.title: V2Request

get.description:
Unauthenticated liveness plus real dependency probes.

Probe detail stays coarse -- a status word and an exception class, never a
host, a credential or an upstream body -- because anyone can call this.
Results are cached briefly so an anonymous caller cannot turn the endpoint
into an outbound request amplifier; the age of the cached answer is
reported rather than hidden.

put.description: Set one agent's toolkit under this key. It only narrows: the key stays the ceiling.

get.description: Stable, secret-free policy evidence for the caller's effective capability set.

post.description:
Take back this caller's approval request while the owner has not answered (for example
when its chat is forgotten). Allowed in lockdown: it only removes authority.
Check a document by the rules publishing applies. Saves, grants and runs nothing.

get.description: Whether the presented key decides by his policy, and the tools on his floor.

post.description: Lets the presented key's "run" decisions skip his confirmation (never on the floor).
A key bound to one agent of the chat's key, for that agent's CLI or MCP. Shown once.

get.description:
Whether ToolGate is in lockdown (no tool or workflow runs, read-only ones included, and no
agent can file a request), why, and who set it: the owner, the operator ("admin") or ToolGate
itself ("system", after repeated bad verification callbacks).

post.description:
Turn lockdown on or off with the owner key. On only takes power away, so Pi's gateway asks no
password for it; off gives the power back, so the gateway sends it only with the owner's
password proof.

get.description:
How tools run (time limits, the Terminal's resources, web search, the run window after an
approval) and the revision a save must name. Null numbers keep today's limits.

put.description: Replace them. A stale revision is refused (409); a value past its ceiling is refused (422).

get.description: Whether the presented key may use this tool.

post.description: Grant or revoke the presented key's use of this tool (never an agent's or a bound key's).

The buttons his Inbox shows when this tool asks him; approving still approves only the
exact action.
A sensitive tool always asks him, whatever the chat, agent or AI decides.
